test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 - Operations on 13 such as adding / deleting / multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)

(85,198, 52)

(77, 270, 32)
solution:
The logic followed here is:

logic:** (1st number - 3rd number) × 6 = 2nd number.**

Now, 

For (85, 198, 52)

→ (85 - 52) × 6

→ 33 × 6 = 198.

For (77, 270, 32)

→ (77 - 32) × 6

→ 45 × 6 = 270.

Similarly, for** (62, 90, 47)**

→** (62 - 47) × 6**

→ **15 × 6 = 90.**

Hence, the correct option is **"Option 4".**
